0022600119.text: Charlotte hosts Washington in its fourth game of the season, with the Hornets at 2-1 (1-1 at home) on a one-game winning streak, second in the Southeast and seventh in the East. The Wizards are also 2-1 on a W1 streak, sitting third in the Southeast and sixth in the East. Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee, surgery), while Washington is without AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve). The teams have no games yet in the 2026-27 season series, and in 2025-26 the Hornets won the series 4-0, including a 129-112 win in Washington on February 22, 2026.
